card.name: Linking words in fixed technical phrases
card.fires_on: Small linking words (for, and, is, will) inside stock phrases from drug-label inspection sentences and POSIX/Unix manual text. Also fires on a few word pieces such as 'Shell' or 'ing' in those manuals.

modes.label: Parenteral inspection sentence
modes.description: The word 'for' right after 'inspected visually' in the standard injection-label line.
modes.example: Parenteral drug products should be inspected visually<< for>> particulate matter and discoloration prior

modes.description: Linking verbs or conjunctions in Unix standard text about locale, errno or shell behavior.
